Vditor 4.0.1, Copyright (c) 2018-present B3log, b3log.org (MIT).
https://github.com/Vanessa219/vditor/tree/v4.0.1
Runtime files are unmodified files from the npm vditor 4.0.1 distribution.
Only the editor, Lute engine, English locale, icons and light/dark styles are included.
Optional diagram, math and syntax-highlighting engines are not distributed here.
The editor's default highlight stylesheet and its license are included.
